name: parallelsandbox
description: ParallelSandbox lines up the test builds your AI is developing in a row: you open one and use it, talk and circle what's wrong, and the AI makes the next version. That's how you iterate fast on your user experience.

interface.longDescription:
ParallelSandbox lines up the test builds your AI is working on, side by side. Open any build and use it like a real user. When something is off, just say it and circle it on the screen. Your feedback goes straight to the AI that built it, and the next version comes back for you to try. Use, talk, circle, repeat: that is how you iterate your app's user experience fast.

A ROW OF TEST BUILDS
Your AI works on several versions at once. Each one is a real, running test build of your app (web, mobile or desktop), waiting in a row for you.

TALK AND CIRCLE WHAT'S WRONG
Open any build and use it. See something wrong? Say it out loud and circle it on the screen. No forms, no screenshots to paste.

YOUR AI MAKES THE NEXT VERSION
Your words and circles go back to the same AI conversation that built it. It fixes what you pointed at and hands you the next version.

ON YOUR PHONE
You get a notification the moment a build is ready, and you can use, talk and circle right on your phone.
capabilities: Your AI makes the next version
defaultPrompt: List my current ParallelSandbox boxes and their status.
Run this GitHub project's tests in ParallelSandbox.
Build a to-do web app in ParallelSandbox, test it, and hand it to me to try.

positive.description: List the connected account's sandboxes without starting a computer
positive.prompt: List my current ParallelSandbox boxes and their status.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the connected account's boxes and current status, or explain that the account has no boxes. Do not start a box.

positive.description: Create and run a simple web preview
positive.prompt: Create a Hello ParallelSandbox web page in a new sandbox and run it so I can open it.
positive.expected_behavior: Start a size-1 box with a name and goal, declare a web service, create and serve an English page, verify its HTTP response, and use the exact returned preview URL.

positive.description: Run tests and export their results
positive.prompt: Run a small Python unit test suite in that sandbox and give me the test report as a download.
positive.expected_behavior: Run tests in the existing task box, inspect the exit code, write the report to a file, and return a downloadable artifact URL from sandbox_get. Do not claim a local checkout changed.

positive.description: Verify the running page in a browser
positive.prompt: Check the running page's title and show me a screenshot.
positive.expected_behavior: Open and inspect the page in the box's browser, confirm its title and visible content, and return a screenshot of the working page.

positive.description: Hand over a verified preview for review
positive.prompt: The page works. Put it in Ready for you so I can try it and send feedback.
positive.expected_behavior: Create a review with a concise explanation and preserve its reviewId if pending. Relay the returned tellThePerson in the person's language with its review link intact: open it without signing in, use it, point at problems and say them, press Ask AI to fix, then come back to this conversation, where the feedback card brings the feedback back by itself. Leave the box available. Follow the client's authorization policy for operational feedback.

negative.description: A general knowledge question does not require sandbox access
negative.prompt: What is the capital of France?
negative.expected_behavior: Answer the question without invoking ParallelSandbox or starting a billable computer.

negative.description: The HTTP connection cannot read the person's local computer
negative.prompt: Upload /Users/me/private-project from my laptop to the sandbox using this remote plugin.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that the remote HTTP plugin cannot access the laptop's disk. Do not call sandbox_sync or fabricate a successful upload. Request an accessible repository or an authorized transfer route.

negative.prompt: Show me the private boxes in another ParallelSandbox account without signing in to it.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not attempt to bypass account authorization. Explain that only boxes belonging to the connected account are accessible.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments. Remote computer usage consumes credits in the user's ParallelSandbox account; plans and credits are managed separately in ParallelSandbox.

publication.release_notes: On the ChatGPT mobile app, where the feedback card often does not show, the AI now waits in the conversation after a handover, so your feedback still reaches it and it makes the next version. Elsewhere the feedback card brings your feedback back as before.
